text: {"name":"hci_send_cmd_0x76","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Allocates and sends message 118, copying a word from the connection context and selecting an accompanying byte according to the associated context state.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v5":"message","v6":"connection_context","v7":"associated_context_index","v8":"associated_context","v9":"associated_context_flag"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":34,"meaning":"Associated context index; 0xFF indicates no associated context."},{"offset":336,"meaning":"Pointer to a nested context object."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Word copied from the nested object into the outgoing message."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Flag selecting which context byte is copied."},{"offset":142,"meaning":"Byte copied when the associated-context flag is clear."},{"offset":689,"meaning":"Fallback byte copied when the associated-context flag is set."}]}
